name: 2328.io – Crypto Payment Gateway for WooCommerce
author: 2328io

sections.description:
2328.io – Crypto Payment Gateway for WooCommerce lets your online store accept cryptocurrency payments directly at checkout. No third-party redirects required, no chargebacks, no monthly fees.

Built for merchants who want a transparent crypto payment gateway with low transaction fees, fast settlement and full WooCommerce integration. Whether you sell physical goods, digital downloads, subscriptions, eSIMs, hosting, SaaS or services — accepting crypto with 2328.io takes less than a day to set up.

Key Features

  • Low fees — from 0.4% per transaction. No setup cost, no monthly fee, no minimum volume.
  • No chargebacks — cryptocurrency payments are final, protecting you from fraudulent disputes.
  • Auto-conversion to stablecoins — every incoming payment can be automatically converted to USDT or USDC, protecting revenue from market volatility.
  • 13 cryptocurrencies, 7 networks — Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, USDC, BNB, TRON, Litecoin, DASH, TON, Avalanche, Polygon, Solana, Dogecoin.
  • Multi-network stablecoins — USDT and USDC available across TRON, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Avalanche, TON and Solana. Customers choose the cheapest network.
  • Fast settlement — funds credited to your merchant account immediately after network confirmations.
  • Real-time exchange rates — invoices priced in your store currency, locked at creation time.
  • Mass payouts — pay affiliates, suppliers and contractors in crypto from the same account.
  • Pass the fee to the customer — built-in option to offset your processing fee per invoice.
  • Per-coin pricing rules — apply discounts or markups to specific coins or networks (e.g. discount for USDT TRC20, markup for high-fee networks).
  • Multilingual checkout — payment page supports 8 languages.
  • Telegram bot payments — every invoice gets a deep link to a Telegram bot, turning each customer into a bot user (free distribution channel).

How It Works

  1. A customer picks Pay with crypto at WooCommerce checkout.
  2. The plugin creates an invoice via the 2328.io API with the current exchange rate.
  3. The customer pays with their preferred wallet — Trust Wallet, MetaMask, Tonkeeper, Phantom, Binance, OKX, any major exchange.
  4. The order is confirmed automatically once the transaction reaches required confirmations.
  5. You can withdraw funds in stablecoins, BTC, ETH or convert internally via SWAP — no exchange account needed.

  • Transparent pricing — flat percentage starting from 0.4%, no hidden costs, no monthly minimums.
  • No chargebacks — once a blockchain confirms a payment, it cannot be reversed by the payer. You decide when to refund.
  • Stablecoin-first settlement — auto-convert incoming payments to USDT or USDC to protect revenue from market swings.
  • Multi-sig custody — funds stored in segregated hot and cold wallets.
  • Engineer-led support — no first-line bots, real technical support via Telegram and email.
  • In crypto since 2017 — long-term operator with a stable product roadmap.

Use Cases

  • Subscription services and SaaS
  • Hosting providers, VPN, eSIM and digital service merchants

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder 2328-io-crypto-gateway-for-woocommerce to /wp-content/plugins/, or install through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin via the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Sign up at 2328.io and create a project to get your API key and merchant ID.
  4. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments and enable 2328.io – Crypto Payment Gateway.
  5. Paste your API key and merchant ID in the gateway settings.
  6. Choose default settlement currency and any per-coin markup/discount rules.
  7. Save and run a test payment.
sections.faq:
How much does it cost?

The transaction fee starts at 0.4%. There is no setup cost, no monthly fee, no minimum volume requirement. For higher monthly volumes, custom rates are available — contact the 2328.io team.

Which cryptocurrencies can my customers pay with?

BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC, BNB, TRX, LTC, DASH, TON, AVAX, POL, SOL and DOGE. Stablecoins (USDT and USDC) are supported across multiple networks — TRON, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Avalanche, TON and Solana — so customers always pick the cheapest network for them.

Will I be exposed to price volatility?

No. The invoice amount is fixed in your store currency (USD, EUR, USDT) at the moment of creation. The exchange rate is locked until invoice expiration. You can also enable auto-conversion so every incoming payment is automatically swapped into USDT or USDC.

Are there chargebacks?

No. Cryptocurrency payments are final once confirmed on the blockchain. This protects your store from fraudulent disputes. Refunds are possible — initiated by you through the merchant dashboard or API.

How long does integration take?

Technically — one day. After you install the plugin and sign up at 2328.io, you can run your first test transaction within minutes.

Who pays the network gas fee?

The customer pays the blockchain network fee. It is shown to them before confirming the payment and does not affect your settlement amount.

Can I pass my processing fee to the customer?

Yes. The gateway supports passing some or all of the processing fee to the payer via an API parameter or a setting in the merchant dashboard.

Is my data secure?

The plugin communicates with 2328.io over HTTPS using HMAC-signed REST API requests. Funds are stored in multi-signature wallets with separated hot and cold balances. Every incoming payment is screened for risk before settlement.

Where can I get support?

Technical support is available via Telegram and email — listed in your 2328.io merchant dashboard. Real engineers respond, not first-line bots.

1.0.1

  • Added translations for 10 languages: Russian, German, Spanish, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish, Japanese, Polish.
  • Added POT translation template.
  • Updated plugin description and SEO metadata for the WordPress.org catalog.
  • Fixed list of supported cryptocurrencies and networks (added Solana, Dogecoin).

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Checkout integration with WooCommerce.
  • Static Wallet and Host-to-Host integration modes.
  • Support for BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC, BNB, TRX, LTC, DASH, TON, AVAX, POL, SOL, DOGE.
  • Multi-network stablecoin payments across TRON, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Avalanche, TON and Solana.
  • Auto-conversion to stablecoins.
  • Real-time exchange rates with locked invoice pricing.
  • Customer-paid network fees.
  • Optional pass-through of processing fee to the payer.
  • Per-coin markup and discount rules.
  • HMAC-signed webhook callbacks.
